metric_contract_audit.micro_relation_f1: Correct: sum per-document unique directed typed triple TP/FP/FN, then compute 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN).
metric_contract_audit.entity_identity: Entity names use NFKC + whitespace collapse + casefold; entity types match the schema strings. Graph IDs and array order are ignored; this is not a span or clinical synonym metric.
metric_contract_audit.multiple_relations: Different relation labels for the same endpoints remain distinct triples; duplicate identical triples deduplicate.
metric_contract_audit.macro_relation_f1: Only gold-supported relation types averaged; zero-support predicted types still contribute micro FP and policy is documented.
metric_contract_audit.empty: Undefined precision/recall/F1=0; invalid prediction adds all gold FN; negative-only correct empty output does not artificially raise positive F1.
metric_contract_audit.pair_exact_accuracy: Can equal 1 for all-negative data while positive F1=0; report it only under exact name and never equate with extraction precision or medical accuracy.
metric_contract_audit.evidence: evidence_exact/compatible scored separately from triples; compatible substring overlap does not demonstrate entailment.
metric_contract_audit.identity: Modern graph/generative path correct and comprehensive CPU checks; historical cache unverified and strict mode opt-in.
metric_contract_audit.shards: Current identity-aware sharding preserves original IDs and combines counts by full recomputation rather than average F1; synthetic test passes.
metric_contract_audit.selection: select_checkpoint uses tune P>=.5/R>=.1 then F0.5 with explicit fallback; full regression not used for per-run checkpoint selection. Repeated experiment decisions mean same 148 should be called regression, not untouched final holdout.

missing_evaluations: Blinded human-adjudicated held-out documents with explicit exhaustive/partial relation annotation status and grouped source isolation.
Fresh live entity->relation predictions with verified input identities; fixed old cache and oracle reported separately.
Same-prompt same-adapter-loader zero-step baseline for DPO/GRPO and at least three training seeds with document/group bootstrap confidence intervals.
Controlled length/order/local experiments with equal supervised positive and verified-negative pair/token exposure.
Real held-out entity prediction error challenge distinct from synthetic absent-name corruption, with complete raw invalid-emission accounting.
Strata by source type (including bare name lists), document/prompt length, entity/pair count, relation count/type, multi-label, evidence distance; no post-hoc exclusion from primary metric.
Rule precision audit: removed TP/FP and source-adjudicated truly unsupported edges; strict silver FP is not medical hallucination.
Exact-match set accuracy only with declared sample/pair denominator; primary extraction precision/recall/F1 remains count-based.
Keep predictions and generations locally in future migrations, plus input, gold, split, code, tokenizer and adapter hashes.
